independence_scope.accidental_exposure: A shell glob intended to exclude the existing Joel chunk path failed and displayed the three chapter-sized fallback scaffold rows. No genuine Joel route or sibling Joel primary was exposed. Disclosed for auditability; fallback rows supplied no positive seam decisions.

evidence_only_guard: Hebrew morphology, Masoretic accents/vocalization, discourse formulae, repeated lexemes, wordplay, speaker shifts, qere/ketiv, translation, ancient-version differences, versification, and internal reuse are boundary evidence only. They select no preferred reading, witness, numbering, speaker, referent, etymology, identity, date, history, fulfillment, canon, authorship, source stratum, ethics, or theology. Roots are not meanings; agreement is evidence, never authority.
macro_parent_alternatives: Joel.1.1-Joel.1.20 superscription, communal witnessing, layered lament, fast summons, day cry, and prophet/creation prayer.
Joel.2.1-Joel.2.17 trumpet alarm, advancing host/day description, return appeal, renewed trumpet, assembly, and priestly plea.
Joel.2.18-Joel.2.27 divine response, removal of destroyer, land/animal/Zion reassurance, restitution, satisfaction, and recognition.
Joel.2.28-Joel.2.32 outpouring, inclusive prophetic signs, cosmic portents, invocation, escape, and called remnant; Hebrew chapter 3.
Joel.3.1-Joel.3.17 restoration frame, nations, named-neighbor address, war summons, harvest judgment, day climax, refuge, and Zion recognition; Hebrew chapter 4.
Joel.3.18-Joel.3.21 abundance, fountain, nation contrast, continuity, blood crux, and Zion-dwelling closure.
Joel.1.13-Joel.2.17 may remain one fast-and-day parent if internal seams fail.
Joel.2.18-Joel.3.21 may remain one response/restoration parent if numbering is mistaken for a seam.

global_holds.versification: Repository coordinates place Hebrew Joel 3 at Joel.2.28-Joel.2.32 and Hebrew Joel 4 at Joel.3.1-Joel.3.21. Preserve continuity without declaring either numbering superior.
global_holds.witnesses: MT/OSHB/UXLC, Septuagint, and other versions expose wording, punctuation, order, and numbering pressure but establish no preferred text.
global_holds.speakers: Prophet, Yahweh, quoted priests, land/animals/Zion, nations, and imperative addressees are local observations; uncertain quotation boundaries remain open.
global_holds.wordplay: Locust terms, shod/Shaddai, moreh, Jehoshaphat, heharuts, shuv shevut, ruach, and niqqah are governed by phrase/discourse, never roots alone.
global_holds.internal_relations: Exodus, Eden, Zion, day-of-YHWH, Spirit, remnant, nations, harvest, refuge, fountain, and later reuse are evidence only, not seam or fulfillment authority.
global_holds.identity_and_history: Locusts, army, northern one, Greeks, mighty ones, places, nations, chronology, date, authorship, redaction, and setting remain deferred.
global_holds.ethics_and_theology: Famine, cult, repentance, agency, warfare, slavery, sexual commerce, retribution, bloodshed, Spirit, salvation, judgment, land, Zion, and restoration are content, not adjudications.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: devar-YHWH asher hayah gives word-event, prophet, and patronymic before the first summons.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Attach heading to Joel.1.2-Joel.1.4 or infer authorship/date.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Nominal heading is complete; attachment remains reviewable.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Generational hearing summons and calamity report
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: shimu/haazinu, interrogative memory, four-generation telling, and fourfold locust remainder chain.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split catalogue from audience/memory frame or make species taxonomy boundary authority.
proposed_chunks.risk: Locust terminology, event identity, oral-transmission scope.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Imperatives and dor/banim frame cumulative ytr/akl chain; taxonomy deferred.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Drunkard wake-up lament and nation/vine devastation
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: haqitsu/bekhu/helilu shifts addressee; ki goy explains wine loss through lion and ruined vine/fig.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach nation image or identify nation/locust/army historically.
proposed_chunks.risk: Wine terms, enemy identity, metaphor, possessives.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Addressee and ki explanation bind; metaphor decides no ontology.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Communal lament over cult, land, and agriculture
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: eli summons lament; offerings, priests, field/ground, crops, workers, and trees culminate in dried joy.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Atomize image, cult, crops, and trees or turn metaphor into biography/rule.
proposed_chunks.risk: Marital image, cult, land personification, crop terms.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Mourning/withering widen from worship to field to human joy.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Priestly mourning, fast, assembly, and cry summons
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Priestly imperatives lead to qaddeshu/qir'u/isfu gathering elders and inhabitants.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Separate priest lament from assembly or merge automatically with day lament.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Dense imperative chain and ministers/house vocabulary form a summons.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Day lament and witnessed food/seed/herd collapse
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: ahah layyom/ki qarov opens; rhetorical witness, seed/granary cruxes, and animal groaning continue catastrophe.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Isolate Joel.1.15 or emend Joel.1.17 to create a seam.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Day cry leads into communal evidence; obscure seed line stays in context.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: First-person cry joined by panting animals
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: elekha YHWH eqra changes to prayer; fire, pasture, trees, streams, and animals close the lament.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Absorb prayer into prior lament or split animals from prophet.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Vocative and repeated fire/pasture bind human and creation cry.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Zion trumpet alarm and advancing-host/day vision
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: tiq'u shofar/hari'u; day darkness, ke- similes, ordered advance, cosmic quaking, divine voice, mi yekhilennu.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split similes/phases or identify locust/human/supernatural host and fulfillment.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Sustained plural motion and final interrogative make one advance.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Even-now return appeal and who-knows possibility
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: we-gam-attah ne'um-YHWH; shuvu, heart/garment, divine predicates, and mi yodea.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach predicates or possibility as theology, or merge with renewed trumpet.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Return imperatives and causal ki bind appeal; possibility stays open.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Renewed trumpet, total assembly, and priestly plea
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: Second tiq'u shofar; qaddeshu/qir'u/isfu/qabbetsu and quoted priestly appeal.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Separate demographic list, priests, or prayer from gathering.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Imperative chain and purpose-built plea create one scene.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Divine response and removal of the northern one
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: wayqanne/wayahmol/wayya'an response; hineni sholeah and we-et-hatsefoni remove deprivation/reproach.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Fix verb chronology, identify northern one, or settle 'great things' referent.
proposed_chunks.risk: Aspect, speaker, identity, geography, stench, agency.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Response verbs/provisions bind; time and final referent stay open.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: al-tiri, al-tir'u, and gilu address land, animals, Zion; pasture/tree/rain/floor/vat reverse chapter 1.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split each addressee or choose teacher-versus-rain at Joel.2.23.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Three addresses and agricultural reversal cohere; crux preserved.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Restitution, satisfaction, praise, knowledge, and no-shame refrain
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: weshillamti; akhol/savoa/hillel, yada'tem, and doubled lo-yevoshu ammi le'olam.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Detach locusts, satisfaction, divine-name statement, or refrain.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: First-person restitution and repeated shame close response.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Outpouring, signs, portents, and escape/remnant oracle
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: wehayah ahare-khen; eshpokh et-ruhi and social pairs lead to wonders, day, invocation, escape, called remnant.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Cut by English numbering, atomize for later reuse, choose ruach sense, or define fulfillment.
proposed_chunks.risk: Hebrew chapter 3, ruach, all flesh, signs, salvation, reuse.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Hebrew five-verse chapter is one outpouring-to-remnant movement.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Restoration-time frame, nations gathered, and indictment
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: ki hinneh bayyamim hahem...asher ashiv; weqibbatsi/wehoradtim lead to scattering/dividing/sale charges.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Use English chapter seam as authority, identify valley, or split sale charge.
proposed_chunks.risk: Hebrew chapter 4, shuv shevut, valley, land, slavery.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Temporal frame and gather/judge verbs govern indictment.

proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: we-gam mah-attem li names addressees; hashillem/hashivoti surround treasures/sold children, ending ki YHWH dibber.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Merge into all nations, identify event, or endorse reciprocal sale.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Vocative and repayment lexemes mark oracle; ethics/history withheld.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: War summons, embedded appeal, judicial assembly, and harvest command
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: qir'u/qaddeshu imperatives; gather/come crosses hanhat appeal and ends with sickle/winepress commands.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split appeal/tools/valley/harvest or authorize holy war.
proposed_chunks.risk: Speakers, war idiom, hanhat syntax, judgment images.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Imperative escalation and gather/come field bind; punctuation deferred.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Valley/day climax, cosmic darkening, roar, refuge, and recognition
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: hamonim/ki qarov yom-YHWH; luminaries, roar, refuge, and widatem close at Zion.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Make heharuts an individual decision appeal, isolate signs, or impose fulfillment.
proposed_chunks.risk: Lexical range, day chronology, refuge, strangers, Zion.
proposed_chunks.hebrew_textual_translation_evidence: Day formula and roar/refuge/knowledge sequence climax; no lexical totality.

proposed_chunks.literary_form: Abundance/fountain finale, contrast, blood crux, and Zion closure
proposed_chunks.deciding_marker: wehayah bayyom hahu; abundance/fountain contrast Egypt/Edom, continuity, niqqeti crux, final YHWH shokhen beTsiyyon.
proposed_chunks.rejected_alternative: Split fountain/nations/blood/dwelling or choose cleanse/avenge rendering/geography.
